query: Which interpretability methods (embedding correlation, saliency, local perturbation, attention attribution) can map quantum embeddings to porosity, facies, or connectivity?

response.query: Which interpretability methods (embedding correlation, saliency, local perturbation, attention attribution) can map quantum embeddings to porosity, facies, or connectivity?
response.answer: Saliency and local perturbation methods can map quantum embeddings to porosity, facies, or connectivity. Attention attribution is less commonly used for this purpose. These methods help understand model predictions.
